representation: per-feature median of 12 monthly standardized log ratios in 2023
selection_scope: Chosen on the development set after comparing the prespecified grid; not a preregistered universal optimum.
reason: K=4 has highest annual silhouette among candidates with no cluster smaller than 20 territories (0.2402). Global spectral K=4 has 0.3624 but minimum cluster size 8.
Monthly KMeans K=4 silhouette 0.2425-0.2526 supports the coarse profile partition.
Month-block ARI median 0.8875, range 0.6921-0.9449 in six development perturbations; seed ARI 0.9901-0.9983.
Feature omission sensitivity remains material (ARI 0.3225-0.8189) and must be shown, not hidden.
Continuous profile and temporal-consensus peers remain distinct alternatives; the holdout will test their utility against hard clusters.
limitations: K grid restricted to 4,6,8,12; no claim of globally optimal K
Complete cohort selected retrospectively using both years
Categories are modelled relative intensities, not verified additive budget shares
